whoWeAre.heading: Ummah Imwe,
whoWeAre.p1: Umuryango w'Abasilamu bo mu Rwanda (RMC), wahoze witwa AMUR, uhagarariye Abasilamu mu Rwanda, amateka yabo akaba arenga ikinyejana. Isilamu yinjijwe mu Rwanda mu mpera z'ikinyejana cya 19 n'abacuruzi b'Abaswahili baturutse ku nkombe z'iburasirazuba bwa Afurika, igenda ikwirakwira buhoro buhoro mu baturage bo mu mijyi n'abasigajwe inyuma. Mu gihe cy'ubukoloni bw'Abadage n'Ababiligi, Abasilamu bahuye n'ivangura, kwirukanwa mu burezi no mu kazi, n'ihezwa mu mibereho.
whoWeAre.p2: Nyuma yo kubona ubwigenge mu 1962, Abasilamu bakomeje kuba bake kandi birinda cyane amacakubiri ashingiye ku moko, bashimangira ubumwe bushingiye ku idini. Mu gihe cya jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi mu Rwanda, abayobozi b'Abasilamu bamaganye urugomo, baharanira ubumwe, kandi imisigiti yabaye ahantu h'ubuhungiro, bituma Isilamu igira isura nziza nyuma yaho.
whoWeAre.point1: Iboneka mu ntara zose 5 na disitiriki 30
whoWeAre.point3: Ukwemera, uburezi, n'imibereho myiza ahantu hamwe
whoWeAre.point4: Imiyoborere igaragara kandi ishingiye ku baturage
whoWeAre.p3: Mu gihe cyakurikiye jenoside, Isilamu yagize iterambere rihoraho biturutse ku bwisanzure, uburinganire, no gufunguka byiyongereye, bituma Abasilamu basangiza benshi ukwemera kwabo. Muri iki gihe, Abasilamu bangana na 5–10% by'abaturage b'u Rwanda, binjiye neza mu mibereho rusange kandi bagira uruhare rugaragara mu biganiro hagati y'amadini no mu bumwe bw'igihugu. Umuryango ubu uyobowe na Mufti Sheikh SINDAYIGAYA Musa, ushinzwe imirimo y'idini no guhagararira umuryango.

e1.title: Intangiriro
e1.text: Imiryango y'Abasilamu mu Rwanda itangira guhuza imbaraga kugira ngo ikorere abaturage bayo ifite icyerekezo kimwe.

e2.title: Ubumwe bw'Igihugu
e2.text: Imiryango yunga ubumwe iyobowe n'urwego rumwe rw'igihugu, hashyirwaho RMC nk'umuryango mukuru w'Abasilamu mu Rwanda.

e3.title: Iterambere n'Uburezi
e3.text: Kwagura amashuri ya Islamu, imisigiti, na gahunda z'imibereho bigera mu ntara na disitiriki zose.

e4.title: Ikoranabuhanga
e4.text: RMC yakira ikoranabuhanga kugira ngo ihuze abanyamuryango, isangire ubumenyi, kandi itange serivisi kuri interineti.

e5.title: Ummah Iteye Imbere
e5.text: Gukorera Abasilamu barenga 500,000 hatangwa serivisi z'amadini, uburezi, imari, n'imibereho mu gihugu hose.

f1.a: Iyo inyandiko zawe zimaze kugenzurwa, Nikah ishobora gukorwa mu cyumweru kimwe kugeza kuri bibiri bitewe n'uko bishoboka.

f2.a: Yego — abashyingiranwa bombi bagomba kuba banditse muri RMC.

f3.a: Kiremewe mu muryango nk'ikimenyetso cy'ubukwe bw'Abayisilamu. Ku iyandikwa rya leta, kurikiza inzira y'ubuyobozi bw'aho utuye.

f4.q: Ibirori bishobora gukorerwa ahantu hacu bwite?
f4.a: Yego — bitewe n'uko imamu aboneka, mu musigiti, mu rugo rwawe, cyangwa ahandi hantu humvikanyweho.

s1.title: Injira
s1.text: Injira kuri konti yawe ya RMC, cyangwa wiyandikishe mu munota umwe niba uri mushya.

s2.title: Uzuza amakuru yawe
s2.text: Andika amakuru yawe bwite n'umwanya usaba.

s3.title: Ohereza inyandiko zawe
s3.text: Ohereza ibaruwa isaba, CV, Indangamuntu, icyemezo cy'imyifatire n'impamyabumenyi.

s4.title: Ongeraho icyemezo cy'imyifatire
s4.text: Genzura nimero y'icyemezo cy'imyifatire, cyangwa uohereze icyemezo.

s5.title: Ohereza & ukurikirane
s5.text: Ohereza ubike nimero yo gukurikirana kugira ngo urebe aho isaba rigeze.

landing.needSubtitle: Bitegure mbere yo gutangira — ushobora kohereza PDF, dosiye za Word cyangwa amafoto.

need.r6: Icyemezo cy'imyifatire myiza — nimero yo kugenzura, cyangwa dosiye yo kohereza

f1.q: Ese nkeneye konti kugira ngo nsabe?
f1.a: Yego. Kwinjira bidufasha kukugeraho kandi bigufasha gukurikirana isaba ryawe kuva ku ntangiriro kugeza ku cyemezo.

f2.q: Ni ubuhe bwoko n'ingano ya dosiye nshobora kohereza?
f2.a: PDF, dosiye za Word n'amafoto (JPG cyangwa PNG). Buri mwanya werekana ingano ntarengwa, kandi dosiye zigenzurwa mbere yo koherezwa.

f3.q: Byagenda gute ntabonye nimero y'icyemezo cy'imyifatire?
f3.a: Nta kibazo — ushobora kohereza kopi cyangwa ifoto y'icyemezo aho kwandika nimero.

f4.q: Nkurikirana nte aho isaba ryanjye rigeze?
f4.a: Fungura urupapuro rwa "Reba aho rigeze" winjire. Uzabona buri ntambwe: ryoherejwe, rirasuzumwa, ryatoranyijwe n'icyemezo cya nyuma.

header.intro: Tangira na niyya yawe — umugambi uri inyuma y'impano yawe — hanyuma uhitemo aho igana. Buri ntererano rirambuye kandi ni ikizere.

quickGive.title: Tanga aho bikenewe cyane
quickGive.subtitle: Uzi umubare? Wongereho mu kanya gato — RMC ikohereza aho bikenewe cyane.

school.title: Uburezi
school.long: Fungurira ubumenyi abana b'ejo — kuva mu masomo ya Qur'an kugeza kuri buruse za kaminuza ku banyeshuri b'inararibonye badashobora kwishyura.

charity.title: Impuhwe
charity.long: Ubufasha butaziguye ku bakeneye cyane — imfungurwa ku miryango ikennye, kwita ku mfubyi, n'ubuvuzi ku batabona uko bivuza.

religious.title: Iby'idini
religious.long: Shyigikira amazu y'Imana n'abayakorera — kubungabunga imisigiti, gufasha ba imamu, no gushyira Qur'an mu maboko y'umuryango.

events.title: Ibirori
events.long: Huza umuryango (ummah) — terera inkunga amahuriro akomeza ukwemera n'umuryango, kuva mu birori bya Idi kugeza ku makambi y'urubyiruko n'amarushanwa y'igihugu.

scholarship.label: Ikigega cya Buruse
scholarship.long: Buruse zuzuye n'iz'igice ku banyeshuri b'inararibonye baturuka mu miryango ikennye, zishyura uko bakomeza amashuri kugeza barangije.

madrassa.label: Madrassa n'Ibitabo
madrassa.long: Guha amashuri ya Qur'an mu ntara zose ibitabo n'ibikoresho abana bakeneye kugira ngo bige gusoma no kwiga Qur'an ku mutwe.

teachers.label: Gufasha Abarimu
teachers.long: Inkunga n'amahugurwa ku barimu n'abacengezamatwara batanga ubuzima bwabo mu kwigisha umuryango.

foodbank.label: Ikigega cy'Ibiribwa
foodbank.long: Imifuka y'ibiribwa by'ibanze buri kwezi ku miryango ifite ingorane, hamwe n'inkunga yiyongera muri Ramadhan.

orphans.label: Kurera Imfubyi
orphans.long: Tera inkunga ibikenewe by'ingenzi ku mfubyi kugira ngo ikure ifite agaciro, ifunguro n'uburezi.

medical.label: Ubufasha mu Buvuzi
medical.long: Kwishyura ibiganiro by'ubuvuzi, imiti n'ubuvuzi bwihutirwa ku batabona uko bivuza.

masjid.label: Kubungabunga Imisigiti
masjid.long: Gukomeza imisigiti isukuye, ifite urumuri kandi iri mu mimerere myiza — kuva ku matereza kugeza ku gisenge n'ahantu ho gukora wudhu.

imam.label: Gufasha ba Imamu
imam.long: Inkunga, amahugurwa n'ubufasha mu butumwa ku ba imamu bayobora amasengesho bakanakorera imiryango yabo.

quran.label: Gukwirakwiza Qur'an
quran.long: Gucapa no gukwirakwiza Qur'an kugira ngo buri rugo na buri musigiti bibone igitabo cy'Imana.

e1.title: Umunsi Mukuru wa Idi al-Adha ku Rwego rw'Igihugu
e1.long: Kwakira umunsi mukuru wa Idi al-Adha ku rwego rw'igihugu — amasengesho, igitambo n'ifunguro rusange bihuza ibihumbi by'abemera.

e2.title: Umuhango wa RMC wo Guha Buruse buri Mwaka
e2.long: Kwizihiza no gutera inkunga itsinda rishya ry’abanyeshuri ba RMC mu muhango wa buri mwaka wo guha ibihembo, dushimira ubuhanga mu masomo.

e3.title: Inama y'Ubuyobozi bw'Abagore b'Abayisilamu
e3.long: Guha imbaraga abagore b'Abayisilamu binyuze mu nama y'ubuyobozi irimo amahugurwa, uburezi n'iyubakwa ry'urusobe mu gihugu hose.

e4.title: Irushanwa ryo Gusoma Qur'an — Fainali z'Igihugu
e4.long: Gukora fainali z'igihugu z'irushanwa ryo gusoma Qur'an, dushimira abazi Qur'an ku mutwe bo mu Rwanda.

e5.title: Inteko Rusange ya RMC
e5.long: Gushyigikira iterana ry'Inteko Rusange ya RMC — ihuriro ry'imiyoborere riyobora imirimo y'umuryango.

projects.title: Imishinga Yacu
projects.desc: Imishinga n'ibikorwa by'umuryango w'Abayisilamu mu Rwanda biri hafi kugaragazwa.
projects.etaDesc: Itsinda ryacu ririmo gukora iyi paji. Garuka vuba kureba ibishya.
projects.expectP1: Iyi paji nimara gushyirwaho, uzashobora kureba imishinga ya RMC iri gukorwa n'iyarangiye — kubaka imisigiti, amashuri, n'iterambere ry'abaturage — hamwe n'amafoto, amakuru y'aho igeze, n'inkuru z'ingaruka.
projects.expectP2: Mu gihe utegereje, twandikire kandi itsinda ryacu rizishimira kukubwira byinshi ku mishinga iriho.
